en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing the main entrance to a military complex. The foreground features a gated entrance with masonry pillars and iron gates leading into a courtyard. Behind the gate stand several large, symmetrical multi‑storey barracks-style buildings with steep tiled roofs and many windows, plus a long low building and a tower-like structure further inside the compound. The text "Bautzen." appears at the upper left and "Haupteingang zur Artilleriekaserne." at the upper right.
